description:
Run JavaScript that drives tabs with the same tools, several steps in one call: loops over pages, forms filled in a go, a list scrolled until a row shows. Each method is the tool of the same name and goes through the same checks (Send, Pay and the like still wait for the user). Synchronous (await is fine and does nothing). Print with console.log; the value you return is printed too. A failed step throws with the tool's message.
  const t = open(url)            // or tab(id), tabs()
  t.snapshot({interactive})      // text; t.refs(/Invite/) → [{ref, line}], t.find('Save') → ref or null
  t.click(ref) t.click({x, y}) t.type(ref, text, {submit}) t.type(text) t.choose(ref, value)
  t.press(keys) t.hover(ref) t.drag(ref, toRef) t.drag(ref, {dx, dy}) t.scroll(ref|null, dy)
  t.dialog(accept, text) t.text() t.wait(forText) t.navigate(url) t.fetch(url) t.show() t.close()
  sleep(ms), keep (an object that lasts between runs)
Each action returns what changed on the page, as the tool does. At most 200 steps a run.
